atoms.name: 2-D address, row and column major
atoms.one_line: Row-major: base + (i*cols + j)*size. Column-major swaps the roles.

atoms.name: Pointer arithmetic
atoms.one_line: p+k moves k elements, not k bytes. a[i] is *(a+i).

atoms.name: 2-D arrays as arrays of arrays
atoms.one_line: a[i] is a row that decays to a pointer. a+1 steps a whole row.

atoms.name: Shifting cost and search
atoms.one_line: Index access O(1). Insert or delete in the middle O(n). Binary search needs sorted data.

atoms.name: Traversal order and paging
atoms.one_line: Walk memory in storage order. Wrong order means more page faults.

atoms.name: Initialisers, bounds and aliasing
atoms.one_line: C zero-fills the tail. Python lists alias. Negative indices count from the end.

atoms.name: Single-pass array algorithms
atoms.one_line: Running sums, two pointers, reversals. Prove the loop invariant, then count passes.
